articles.summary: If you live in Ohio, you might have heard of the Ohio PASSPORT Waiver. PASSPORT is an acronym that stands for Preadmission Screening System Providing Options and Resources Today. It is a Medicaid Waiver that helps older Ohioans live independently in their own homes for longer by providing options for long-term care services and support.
articles.title: Empowering Ohio's Seniors: Exploring the PASSPORT Waiver
